note: Allowed kinds for '## [date] kind | title' headings in log.md. A kind names the activity, not the topic. The linter fails on an undeclared kind and on a declared kind nothing uses.

kinds.ingest: compiled a source from raw/ into wiki pages
kinds.decision: recorded a change of direction or schema
kinds.hygiene: ran the hygiene pass or the organization checklist
kinds.lint: ran the linter and fixed what it found
